scenario.title: Meeting Summary and Email Reporting
scenario.initial_description: After a meeting, the contents are summarized and shared by email with the relevant people.

reference_workflow.goal: Summarize meeting content and distribute decisions, owners, and deadlines to relevant stakeholders.

activities.name: Confirm unclear items with decision owners

decisions.condition: Are all action items assigned to owners?
Does the meeting require task tracking?

automation_opportunities.rationale: Decision and action-item extraction can be supported by summarization models.
Task tracker updates can be generated from action-item tables.

activities.name: Review and Approve Meeting Summary
activities.system: Email Client or Document Review Tool

activities.name: Compose Summary Email
outputs: Composed email with summary attached or embedded

activities.name: Archive Meeting Summary
activities.system: Document Management System or File Storage

decisions.condition: Is the draft meeting summary accurate and complete?
Are all intended recipients included in the list?

exceptions.description: Meeting recording or notes are incomplete or unavailable
exceptions.handling: Request supplementary notes from attendees before proceeding with summary drafting

exceptions.description: Email delivery failure for one or more recipients
exceptions.handling: Resend email to failed recipients or use alternative communication channel

exceptions.description: Key stakeholder not included in original attendee or distribution list
exceptions.handling: Update recipient list and resend summary email with note explaining late inclusion

exceptions.description: Meeting summary contains confidential information requiring restricted distribution
exceptions.handling: Apply access controls and limit distribution to authorized recipients only

automation_opportunities.target: A2 - Collect and Organize Meeting Notes
automation_opportunities.rationale: Transcription and note-organization tools can automatically capture spoken content during meetings and structure it into topics, action items, and decisions without manual effort.
constraints: Requires consent from all participants for recording
Accuracy depends on audio quality and speaker clarity

automation_opportunities.rationale: Natural language processing and AI summarization tools can generate structured meeting summaries from transcripts or organized notes, reducing manual writing time significantly.
constraints: Output quality may require human review for nuanced or sensitive discussions
Template or format guidelines must be provided

automation_opportunities.target: A4 - Review and Approve Meeting Summary
automation_opportunities.rationale: Automated review workflows can route the draft summary to the meeting chair for approval with a single click, triggering next steps upon approval without manual follow-up.
constraints: Human approval step should be retained to ensure accuracy and accountability
Timeout or escalation rules needed if approver is unresponsive

automation_opportunities.rationale: Recipient lists can be automatically populated from the meeting calendar invite attendees and predefined distribution groups, eliminating manual lookup.
constraints: Distribution lists must be kept current
Role-based access rules may restrict certain recipients

automation_opportunities.rationale: Email composition can be automated using predefined templates that embed the approved meeting summary, subject line, and recipient list, requiring only final review before sending.
constraints: Templates must be maintained and updated as communication standards evolve

automation_opportunities.rationale: Sending can be fully automated upon approval of the meeting summary, triggering immediate or scheduled email dispatch without manual intervention.
constraints: Should include a short delay or confirmation step to allow for last-minute corrections

automation_opportunities.rationale: Archiving can be automated by routing the final summary document to a designated folder or document management repository upon email send confirmation.
required_data: Archive folder structure or naming convention
constraints: Archive location and taxonomy must be predefined and consistently maintained

automation_opportunities.target: D1 - Is the draft meeting summary accurate and complete?
automation_opportunities.rationale: Automated quality checks (e.g., checking for presence of required sections such as action items, attendees, date) can flag incomplete summaries before human review, reducing back-and-forth.
constraints: Semantic accuracy still requires human judgment
Rules must be defined for what constitutes completeness

assumptions: The meeting produces identifiable outputs such as notes, action items, or a recorded transcript that can serve as source material for the summary.
There is a designated individual responsible for producing and distributing the meeting summary.
Recipients are defined either through meeting attendance records or predefined distribution lists.
The summary is distributed via email as the primary channel; other channels are not considered in scope.
Approval of the summary by the meeting chair or organizer is required before distribution.
Meeting summaries may need to be archived for future reference or compliance purposes.
The workflow applies to recurring and ad hoc meetings alike.
Confidentiality and access control requirements may vary by meeting type and are handled case by case.
